_description: Curated list of typical EMS field names by database. Names may vary between EMS deployments; treat as a vocabulary hint and resolve to IDs with find_fields. Not a substitute for discovery.
_usage: After reading this resource, call find_fields(search_text=[...]) with the names you need to resolve them to actual field IDs.

FDW Flights.name: Flight Record
FDW Flights.description: Unique flight record identifier (primary key). Required to drive query_flight_analytics.

FDW Flights.name: Flight Date
FDW Flights.description: Date the flight took place. Common filter target for date-range queries.

FDW Flights.name: Flight Number
FDW Flights.description: Operator's flight number (e.g. QF1).

FDW Flights.name: Tail Number
FDW Flights.description: Aircraft registration (e.g. VH-OQA). Discrete: filter accepts numeric code or label - use get_field_info or include_field_info=True to see codes.

FDW Flights.name: Aircraft Type
FDW Flights.description: Aircraft model (e.g. A330-200, B737-800). Filter on label or code.

FDW Flights.name: Fleet
FDW Flights.description: Fleet grouping that the aircraft belongs to. Discrete codes.

FDW Flights.name: Takeoff Airport Code
FDW Flights.description: ICAO/IATA code of departure airport. Discrete codes - use get_assets(asset='airports') for the full mapping.

FDW Flights.name: Takeoff Airport Name
FDW Flights.description: Free-text name of departure airport.

FDW Flights.name: Landing Airport Code
FDW Flights.description: ICAO/IATA code of arrival airport. Discrete codes.

FDW Flights.name: Landing Airport Name
FDW Flights.description: Free-text name of arrival airport.

FDW Flights.name: Takeoff Time
FDW Flights.description: Local or UTC takeoff timestamp (variants exist - search both).

FDW Flights.name: Landing Time
FDW Flights.description: Local or UTC landing timestamp.

FDW Flights.name: Block Time
FDW Flights.description: Total gate-to-gate time. Units typically seconds or minutes.

FDW Flights.name: Flight Time
FDW Flights.description: Wheels-up to wheels-down duration. Units typically seconds or minutes.

FDW Flights.name: Fuel Burned
FDW Flights.description: Total trip fuel burn. Units typically kg or lb.

FDW Flights.name: Takeoff Fuel
FDW Flights.description: Fuel onboard at takeoff. Units typically kg or lb.

FDW Flights.name: Landing Fuel
FDW Flights.description: Fuel onboard at landing.

FDW Flights.name: Takeoff Weight
FDW Flights.description: Gross weight at takeoff (TOW). Units kg or lb.

FDW Flights.name: Landing Weight
FDW Flights.description: Gross weight at landing.

FDW Flights.name: Cruise Altitude
FDW Flights.description: Maximum cruise altitude. Units feet.

FDW Flights.name: Flight Phase
FDW Flights.description: Phase of flight - usually used as an aggregation/group dimension. Discrete codes.

FDW Flights.name: Departure Runway
FDW Flights.description: Runway used for takeoff (e.g. 16L).

FDW Flights.name: Arrival Runway
FDW Flights.description: Runway used for landing.

FDW Flights.name: Number of Engines
FDW Flights.description: Engine count for the aircraft.

FDW Flights.name: Operator
FDW Flights.description: Operating airline. Discrete codes.

APM Events.name: Flight Record
APM Events.description: Foreign key to FDW Flights for the parent flight.
